name: Awaiting Reply
description: A weekday-morning Scout automation that finds emails you sent that asked for something and never got an answer, reports how many are waiting, and prepares follow-up drafts in each thread's own language that it never sends.
author: Allan De Castro
coverImageAlt: A sent envelope waits across a tether while an unsent follow-up draft rests under a glass weight.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a sent request patiently waiting for a response while a safe follow-up draft is prepared but remains unsent
Scene/backdrop: a minimal warm-paper correspondence table floating in a deep slate field, with quiet open space suggesting elapsed time
Subject: one cyan outgoing envelope resting at the far end of a taut thread between two small mail trays, a series of subtle concentric waiting rings behind it, and a second blank folded note held securely under a translucent glass weight to show a prepared draft that has not been sent
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; simple strong silhouette legible at small card size
Lighting/mood: patient, attentive, quietly technical; calm cyan backlight and one sparing orange status accent
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: every paper and envelope surface must remain completely blank; no text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding
